decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - the proposed side and rear extension would not be harmful to neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the building and the surrounding area, and would be in line with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the Residential Extension Guidelines, of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.  Accordingly, approval is recommended.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity.)

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents.)

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenities of the neighbouring residential property against increased overlooking with resultant loss of privacy.)

Condition : 6 - Informatives
Permission has been granted on the basis of the position of the windows in the rear wall of the approved extension being as shown on the proposed floor plan and not the proposed rear elevation, which are incorrectly shown.
Condition : 7 - Thames Water advise that they should be contacted for their approval as there are public sewers crossing the site.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house
